Tecsys Elite WMS cost

Tecsys Elite WMS is mid-market with deep healthcare-distribution chops and a growing 3PL footprint. Subscription is per-user and per-warehouse, quote-only. Elite Streamline added low-code configuration in 2025.

[SKU-A / PRICING POSTURE]

Quote-only

Subscription tiers, per-user and per-warehouse; quote only[s-09].

[SKU-B / COST DRIVERS]

What changes the quote

  • Healthcare vertical adds chargeback, lot/serial, and FEFO complexity that inflates SI hours.
  • Multi-warehouse and multi-tenant 3PL tiers.
  • Streamline low-code configuration reduces consulting but adds platform fee.
  • Visual Logistics (returns, kitting) is a separate module.
[SKU-C / RECENT CHANGES]

2025-26 product and pricing

Healthcare distribution remains the lead vertical. Elite Streamline added more low-code configuration for complex 3PL workflows in 2025.

[SKU-D / FIT]

When this vendor is the answer

  • Healthcare distribution where lot/serial and recall handling matter.
  • Complex distribution with chargeback and customer-specific compliance.
  • Mid-market 3PL wanting an alternative to Korber or Extensiv.
[SKU-E / FAQ]

Buyer questions

Why is Tecsys strong in healthcare?

Tecsys grew up on hospital-supply distribution. Lot/serial, expiry, recall handling, and chargeback are first-class concepts in the data model.

Tecsys vs Korber for 3PL?

Korber's HighJump heritage is more 3PL-native. Tecsys is stronger if you also distribute regulated goods.
